Name: Custom Community Centre
Author: bblueberry
Description:
[size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/MKNXkbt.png[/img]

[b]• [color=#a4c2f4]Choose your tools:[/color][/b]
If you're making a [b]JSON content pack[/b], refer to the example pack [url=https://github.com/b-b-blueberry/CustomCommunityCentre/tree/master/%5BCCC%5D%20CommunityLounge][CCC] Community Centre Lounge[/url].
If you're working with [b]C#[/b], refer to the released mod [url=https://github.com/b-b-blueberry/CustomCommunityCentre/tree/master/CommunityKitchen]Community Centre Kitchen[/url].
﻿﻿See the [url=https://github.com/b-b-blueberry/CustomCommunityCentre/blob/master/author-guide.md]author guide[/url] for more information. (coming soon)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Woj7Uur.png[/img]﻿

[b]• [color=#b4a7d6]Requirements:[/color][/b]
[b]Requires the Stardew Valley 1.5.5 beta.[/b]
If you don't know what this is, bookmark this page and come back when 1.5.5 is officially released.
For the time being, this mod and any mods that require it are Android-incompatible.
[b]• [color=#b4a7d6]Multiplayer:[/color][/b]
[b]Make sure everyone has the mod installed before playing multiplayer.[/b]
﻿All players should use the same Community Centre mods as the host.
[b]• [color=#b4a7d6]Compatibility:[/color][/b]
[b]Compatible with most bundle mods.[/b]
﻿Tested with Challenging Community Center Bundles and Vegan Bundles.
﻿All custom bundles are added to the world without breaking any others.
[b]• [color=#b4a7d6]Save files:[/color][/b]
[b]﻿Safe to add to existing save files.[/b]
﻿Savegames with the community centre already completed won't be changed at all.
﻿Savegames with an in-progress CC will need to finish the new bundles before it's complete.
Remove the mod at any time to restore the CC to normal and return any donated items.


﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[url=https://github.com/b-b-blueberry/CustomCommunityCentre]>> github[/url][/size]
